## Parent
- Program: #382
- Goal: #386
- Related incidents: mayf3/agent-control#1249
- Related Products: #525 (deployment seam canary family, separate scope), #546 (same-day router/scheduler incident, separate scope)

## Problem
The 2026-10-21 023rb deployment exposed two deployment-introduced session compatibility failures that share one release-boundary root class: a newly loaded runtime can reject session data/logs written by the immediately preceding generation.

1. Old wrapped replayState records deterministically fail resume with INVALID_REPLAY_STATE under the new loader/runtime shape.
2. dsh-codex writes transport event `web/openai-codex-search-llm-request` without a load-compatible registered/ignorable contract, so harness restart can make the whole session unloadable.

Both failures can stay latent until a process/session restart, so ordinary health checks may remain green while fleet agents are one restart away from failure.

## Requirement
Fix the compatibility boundary using existing session loader/event registry/deployment-test surfaces. Keep this one grouped Product for the two same-release compatibility defects; do not split per finding and do not widen #525/#546 beyond their current accepted scope.

## DONE_WHEN
1. RED reproduction on current merged source for both exact defects:
   - wrapped legacy replayState resumes fail under the new loader;
   - logs containing the codex web-search transport event fail supported-session load after restart.
2. Add the smallest backward-compatible replay loading/migration path:
   - legacy wrapped schema is explicitly accepted/migrated into the current in-memory form;
   - current flat schema remains unchanged;
   - malformed/unknown replay state still fails closed.
3. Fix the transport-event contract so newly written codex web-search diagnostic events are load-safe across harness restart, using existing registry/ignorable semantics; no blanket ignore of unknown event types.
4. Existing historical session files are not bulk-rewritten or rotated by this source action. Preserve backups and UNKNOWN/no-replay semantics.
5. Focused tests cover old+new replayState forms, malformed fail-closed cases, event registry/ignorable behavior, and restart/reload idempotency.
6. Add one bounded non-production restart/resume canary fixture proving an existing-session log produced by the previous shape can be loaded and one model-call boundary reached after restart using test identity/mocked provider surfaces where required.
7. Independent changed-surface review PASS / zero load-bearing blockers.
8. Freeze an exact release/rollback/canary packet if source/tests/review pass; no production mutation in the source lane.
9. Production delivery, if later authorized separately, must verify a small existing-session resume sample before broader restart exposure and must rollback on first post-mutation failure.
10. Close only when INSTALLED=yes / ENABLED=yes / BUSINESS_VERIFIED=yes from real bounded acceptance.

## Boundaries
- No bulk fleet session rewrite/rotation.
- No raw manual patching of production session files as the Product implementation.
- No new watcher/platform/database.
- No weakening UNKNOWN/no-replay or unknown-event fail-closed semantics beyond the exact registered/ignorable transport contract.
- No merge/deploy/restart/sudo/credential/config/data mutation from a CAPACITY_AVAILABLE event.
- Preserve current factual writers; use agent-control as the only local execution command bus.
